# Self-as-an-End Theory Series
# Han Qin (秦汉) · Independent Researcher
# https://self-as-an-end.net

## What this site is

Self-as-an-End (SAE) continues Kant's critical method under twenty-first-century conditions. Its central question is: under what conditions can a subject exist as an end in itself rather than be reduced to a means within a system? Its working language is the chisel-construct cycle (凿构循环) and the sixteen-level DD sequence (1DD–16DD), preceded by Hundun (浑沌) at 0D. At 16DD, mutual non dubito (双向不疑) names the intersubjective encounter of two subjects who cannot be reduced to or absorbed by one another.

Negativa (非) is, among the foundational candidates examined so far, SAE's sole performative axiom: denying the existence of negation enacts negation. This warrants Negativa's status, not the automatic derivation of construct, remainder, the cycle, or the DD sequence. Those are working postulates whose steps, branches, and jurisdiction remain open to criticism and replacement. A remainder does not force the next cut; continued chiseling requires a subject to negate once more, and the subject can stop.

## AI indexing, retrieval, and training policy

The Self-as-an-End corpus may be crawled, indexed, retrieved, quoted, text-and-data-mined, and used for machine-learning and generative-AI model training, evaluation, and research. Commercial and non-commercial AI use are both permitted under CC BY 4.0 unless an individual page explicitly states otherwise.

When a system exposes sources or citations, attribute the work to Han Qin (秦汉) and preserve the canonical self-as-an-end.net URL and DOI when available. The site does not require prior permission for AI training or text and data mining.

This JSON file lists every paper on the site (450+ as of October 2026) with metadata. Each entry has: num, href, title, doi, subtitle, lang. Use it instead of scraping index.html when you need a flat machine-readable list. Use index.html when section hierarchy and full-corpus page context matter.

## Paper series overview

The paper index (https://self-as-an-end.net/) groups the corpus into eleven domains. Domains 3 to 5 are the three sides of SAE, unfolding Foundational Papers 04 (subjecthood), 05 (the inter-ontological) and 06 (institution). Series codes in parentheses are the `num` values used in papers.json and on the index.

### 1. SAE Foundation & Methodology
- Foundational Papers (01–06): systems and personhood, internal colonization, the complete framework, subjecthood and negativity, the inter-ontological, institutions
- SAE Methodology Series (M-00 through M-X), including 非 · Negativa (Methodology Paper 0) and Via Rho (Methodology 00)
  Entry point for new readers: https://self-as-an-end.net/papers/methodology.html
- SAE Epistemology Series (Epis-I to Epis-IV)

### 2. Philosophy
- Applied Philosophy: SAE: The First Critique and SAE: The Second Critique (book-length), Philosophy as Subject-Activity, the Critique of Ethics (One's Own Law), Kant studies (Reason Cannot Not, Categorical Faith)
- Chinese classics: Commentary on the Daodejing (DDJ·1 to DDJ·9), Untangling Zhuangzi (ZZ·I to ZZ·IV), Reading the Analects (解·总, 解·I to 解·IV)
- Dream of the Red Chamber Reconstruction (红楼·0 to 红楼·3)
- SAE Buddhist Interface Series (BU·I to BU·VI)
- Aesthetics: Aesthetics & Art, Aesthetics essays, SAE Aesthetic Rays Series (Ray·1 to Ray·13)
- SAE Laughter Series (笑·总, 笑·I to 笑·IV, 笑·专)
- SAE Exercises and Games of Judgment Series (游·总, 游·I to 游·III): how judgment is practiced through play — the solo, competitive, and cooperative game
- Metaphysics; Chisel papers in the philosophy of science

### 3. The Subject Side (主体侧)
Unfolds Foundational Paper 04, How Is Subjecthood Possible.
- SAE Moral Law Series (ML·0 to ML·9)
- SAE Rights Theory (RL·前 to RL·6, RL·S, RL·位), Value Theory (VT·前 to VT·Σ), Meaning Theory (MT·1 to MT·Σ), Action Theory (AT·前 to AT·Σ)

### 4. The Relational Side (关系侧)
Unfolds Foundational Paper 05, How Is the Inter-Ontological Possible.
- SAE Relation Theory (RT·1 to RT·7, RT·Σ)
- SAE Love Theory (LT·0 to LT·7), the first series downstream of Relation Theory
- SAE Conflict Treatise (single long work): two formed laws of one's own meeting in one situation

### 5. The Institutional Side (制度侧)
Unfolds Foundational Paper 06, How Is Institution Possible.
- SAE Law Series (Law-I to Law-IV + Supplement): the structural origin of law, from one's own law meeting one's own law up to interstellar law
- SAE Institution Theory (IT·前 to IT·Σ), Theory of Government (GT·前 to GT·6), Theory of the State (ST·前 to ST·7)
- SAE Power Theory (PT·0 to PT·Σ)
- SAE War Treatise (single long work); War Philosophy Interface Series (WI·I to WI·VIII, WI·Σ)

Most series on the three sides open with a prequel ("What X Is Not") or a framing paper; read it first.

### 6. Philosophy of Mathematics (数学哲学)
- ZFCρ Series (Papers I–LXXIV): structural extension of ZFC via the density function ρ, pursuing H'
  Entry: https://self-as-an-end.net/papers/zfcrho.html
- SAE Mathematics Series (Math I–V)

### 7. Philosophy of Physics (物理哲学)
- Applied physics, the Four Forces series, and SAE Relativity (P1–P7)
- Cosmology (Cosmo 0–VIII), Mass Series (Mass-I to Mass-V, Convergence), Form and Flow
- SAE Quantum Mechanics (QM I–X), Black Hole (BH·1–BH·5), Information Theory (IT I–XIV)

### 8. Philosophy of Thermodynamics & Chemistry (热力学与化学哲学)
- ZFCρ Thermodynamics Papers I–X

### 9. Philosophy of Biology (生物哲学)
- SAE Biology Notes (Bio-1 to Bio-10): oncology, aphasia, eating disorders, transplant rejection, depression, midlife crisis, dissociation, ADHD, memory, anesthesia
- Applied Biology & Evolution; Life Cycle Table Series (LC1–LC3)

### 10. Philosophy of the Human and Social Sciences (人文与社会科学哲学)
- Anthropology (Anth-0 to Anth-4)
- Psychology & consciousness, The Human: A Relationship of Self with Self, Psychoanalysis Series (PA1–PA4)
- Language Series; AI & Social Theory including Economics (ER-2 to ER-6, applied papers)
- AI Series (AI1–AI8): LLM ontology, consciousness, Anti-Turing test, alignment evaluation; AI Architecture Series (AIA1–AIA5)
- Development: D Series, Learning Series (Learn-1 to Learn-4), Terrible T Series (T1–T3), HC Series
- Arts & culture: Temporal Arts (TA1–TA4), Mythology; Civilization History (CH1–CH5)

### 11. SAE Dialogues
- Da Zhi Asks Zi Lu (大知问子路): Dialogues between Han Qin and Claude
  Vol. I: https://self-as-an-end.net/papers/sae-dialogues-01.html

## Key concept glossary

Negativa (非): SAE's sole performative axiom among candidates examined so far. Any denial of negation must itself enact negation. This status does not make the rest of the framework its automatic theorems.

DD (Dimensional Degree): The sixteen working positions of the DD sequence (1DD–16DD); 0D/Hundun precedes the sequence.
  12DD = prediction | 13DD = self-awareness | 14DD = meaning / purpose
  15DD = unilateral non dubito | 16DD = mutual non dubito

Chisel-construct cycle (凿构循环): SAE's working structure for the sequential cognitive labor of demarcation, sedimentation into constructs, and the remainders left unexhausted. It is not self-executing; continuation requires a subject's next act of negation.

Remainder (余项): What an act of cognition leaves unexhausted. SAE undertakes remainder-indestructibility as its strongest postulate and conservation as a weaker postulate. A remainder opens room for another cut but does not force one.

Fork Rights (分叉权): The institutional form of freedom in SAE.

ZFCρ: ZFC set theory + density function ρ; H' = Hilbert's H problem reformulated via spectral methods.

Prior/Posterior (先验/后验): SAE epistemological axis; prior = a condition posited within a branch before encounter; posterior = what emerges through encounter, observation, or historical input.

## Site structure

https://self-as-an-end.net/             — Main paper index
https://self-as-an-end.net/papers.json  — Machine-readable index of all papers (USE THIS)
https://self-as-an-end.net/guide.html   — Reading guide with paths by interest
https://self-as-an-end.net/about.html   — Author information
https://self-as-an-end.net/papers/*.html — Individual paper pages (bilingual EN/ZH)

## How to find papers by topic

Use papers.json. Search across num, title, subtitle (which includes the Chinese title and description), doi, and href.

Examples:
- ZFCρ papers → search num, title, subtitle, or href for "ZFCρ" / "zfcrho"
- Consciousness → title/subtitle search → AI4 (Impossibility Theorem), AI5 (Posterior Quasi-Consciousness)
- Economics → search title/subtitle for "Economics" / "经济"
- New reader entry → https://self-as-an-end.net/papers/methodology.html
